newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money market rates seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money market rates seen steady.

text.p: Swiss money market rates were seen steady with the Swiss National Bank reported to have added liquidity to the market in routine operations.

One bank quoted tomorrow/next money at 1-1/4 to 1-3/8 percent. A trader said the SNB added overnight liquidity at a rate of 2.00 percent. He said the funds were likely aimed at offsetting demand for liquidity at month's end.
Rates were seen little changed from Thursday when the SNB lowered its discount rate half a point to 1.00 percent. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
